text: That button already exists: Engine tab, bottom, 'Reset engine (new GitHub runner)' (two taps). It ends the running job and starts a new one; GitHub gives each job a fresh runner, usually with a different address. You also don't have to do it: when Novig refuses a runner's address, the engine ends that job by itself and draws another (up to 5 in a row, then one an hour). That just happened at 20:00 UTC and the next run took over. GitHub offers no way to pick an address (a fixed-IP larger runner is a paid feature), so a re-draw is the only lever.
